newsitem.title: USA: South Alabama holders approve Monco merger.
newsitem.headline: South Alabama holders approve Monco merger.

text.p: South Alabama Bancorp Inc said on Tuesday that both its shareholders and First Monco Bancshares Inc shareholders approved an agreement that provides for the merger of First Monco into South Alabama.
South Alabama is the parent company of First National Bank, Brewton and the Bank of Mobile. First Monco is the parent of The Monroe County Bank. All three are in Alabama.
South Alabama said it would become the ninth largest bank holding company in Alabama after the merger, with assets totalling about $341 million.
The merger was set to be completed on October 31, the company said.
